identity: This dog is so heavily mutated you weren't entirely sure of the original animal for a moment.  It has no fur at all, being covered entirely by scales instead, and its serpentine head has yellow eyes and a pair of vicious fangs near the front of its muzzle.  It is not looking at you like it wants you to pet it.

identity: &You deposit the sheet in the tray.  After a long silence, the tray opens again, this time with a pile of coins.  "We imagine what you experienced was harrowing, but we think this may be a localized effect of the portal storm, rather than a new world.  It's difficult to tell from the recordings.  But they are nevertheless valuable, and we have turned them over to Research for further investigation.  Thank you for your contributions to science, as always.  If you return, please note any, let us say, passageways, that you may see, which could, well, lead to other places.  Yes?  Clear?  Thank you."
